Class Hub

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Hub
public final class Hub extends Object
The Tempest hub: /tempest hub place builds a spawn area with a row for each plugin's blocks and a sign for each page, so a server has every Tempest feature in one place in a minute (and our demo server shows them all). Each plugin adds its own row and pages here; Core lays them out, records what was there first, and puts it back on /tempest hub remove. Since API_VERSION 23. 
core.hubArea(new Hub.Area("shop", "Shop", 10, () -> List.of(
        new Hub.Block("Shop_Block", "Market Stall", stalls))));
core.hubPage(new Hub.Page("Shop", "shop", 10));
